description_target.target_text: BFS from red(2) seed through blue(1) path cells. Reachable blue(1)→green(3). Walls(8) block. Unreachable blue(1) stays.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
  (let* ((start (first (find-color g 2)))
         (reachable
           (connected-region
             g (first start) (second start)
             (lambda (_row _col value) (or (= value 1) (= value 2)))
             4))
         (path-cells
           (filter
             (lambda (pos) (= (at g (first pos) (second pos)) 1))
             reachable)))
    (recolor-cells g path-cells 3)))
